notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Push copy frequently uses all-caps and an exclamation point even for non-breaking items, consistent with what copy_analysis.py flags.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] In-app notification settings are nested three taps deep (Settings > Notifications > Manage), with no shortcut from the push itself.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Breaking News toggle ON by default; a separate 'Alerts' category for opinion-adjacent content also defaults ON.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] No frequency control anywhere in Settings > Notifications -- only a per-category on/off, no 'fewer/more' slider.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Pre-prompt shown before the OS permission dialog on first launch, with copy that frames declining as 'maybe later' rather than 'no thanks'.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Follows: auto-enable alerts. On first launch, 'Breaking News' and 'Top Stories' toggles both ship ON; the user never sees an explicit opt-in.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] OS-level channel names (Settings > Apps > Notifications) do not match the in-app category names, which makes cross-referencing the two harder.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] No visible in-app path to mute promotional pushes without also muting the daily news digest -- they share one settings row.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] 'Today's top stories' digest toggle defaults ON alongside a separate 'Deals of the day' promotional category, also defaulting ON.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Team-following flow is separate from the news-alert toggle -- a user can follow a team for scores without enabling general breaking alerts.
notes.author: demo dataset

notes.note: [SAMPLE DEMO NOTE] Subscription-gated: the notification permission pre-prompt appears before the paywall, so a non-subscriber can still opt in to alerts.
notes.author: demo dataset
